annotations.title: Screen a name against EU sanctions (paid)

description: Sanctions screening (AML/KYC) of a person or organisation name against the EU consolidated financial sanctions list (6,000+ persons and entities, aliases included). Fuzzy matching handles spelling variants and word order; returns scored possible matches with EU reference, UN id, programmes, birth dates and countries. Optional type and birth year. For onboarding, compliance, payments and due-diligence agents. Costs $0.005 USDC via x402, or one unit of a Factline API key quota.
